title: Bind Monster
wikitext:
[[Image:BindMonster.png|right|160px]]
Bind Monster is a [[spell]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Casting Modifier''': +4

'''Sanity Cost''': 2

'''Any Phase''': Cast and Discard this spell to pass one [[Combat check]].  You must roll successes equal to the [[monster]]'s [[toughness]] to cast this spell.  This spell doesn't work on [[Ancient One]]s.

'''Hands''': 2
